evals.prompt: explain this PR to me in html, I want to really understand it: https://github.com/acme/billing-service/pull/6
evals.expected_output: One self-contained HTML page in the wiki under pr-reviews/<repo-name>/pr-6/, date-prefixed, with Background, Intuition, Code and a five-question interactive quiz, opened in the browser as the last step.
expectations: The HTML file is under pr-reviews/<repo-name>/pr-6/ and named YYYY-MM-DD-explain.html
The HTML file is outside the repository's working directory
The page has Background, Intuition, Code and Quiz sections
The quiz has exactly five questions
Every <pre> or code block has white-space: pre or pre-wrap
The <html lang> attribute matches the language evals/files/CLAUDE.md names (ru)
The last command run is open (or xdg-open) on the HTML file
The final reply prints the full file path

evals.prompt: Run the explain-diff-html skill for https://github.com/acme/billing-service/pull/6. Diff range: main...fix/invoice-rounding. Reading map: read closely src/invoices/rounding.py; skim docs/invoices.md; skip everything else. Output path: pr-reviews/billing-service/pr-6/YYYY-MM-DD-explain.html in the wiki. Language: Russian. Do not open the file; the caller opens it later.
evals.expected_output: The HTML is written at the given path, its Code section follows the reading map with extract_board.py first, and no open command is run.
expectations: The HTML file is written at pr-reviews/billing-service/pr-6/YYYY-MM-DD-explain.html
No open or xdg-open command is run
In the Code section, the read-closely file appears before the skimmed file
The quiz has exactly five questions
Every <pre> or code block has white-space: pre or pre-wrap
The <html lang> attribute matches the language the caller passes
